snippet_primary: "This is the thing most Payhip reviews gloss over. The platform is excellent at processing a transaction once someone has decided to buy. What it cannot do is bring that person to you in the first place. This is the central challenge of Test 02 for us. We have created three digital products — a ChatGPT prompt workbook, an AI tools directory and a Whiteout Survival strategy guide — listed them on Payhip and priced them reasonably. The products are live. The checkout works. But without traffic, nothing sells."
